corda, cordium n. pl.

noun, third declension, plural · Declension on Wiktionary

The plural of cor, heart; the genitive with a rank: rēx cordium, the king of hearts. Lewis & Short finds the genitive plural cordium only in the Vulgate.

Other words

  • cor, cordis n. — a heart (one card of the suit)

    noun, third declension · also used · modern · Traupman 51 · Declension on Wiktionary

See also suit, diamonds, spades, clubs.
